401-2530-3845-3944.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2530-3845-3944.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat.

1981-2415-6559-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
1981-2415-6559-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

813-1181-2171.description:
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven {B}.
Cast Persist by paying its mana cost, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Sacrifice and Persist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5789-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5789-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2292-2738-4871-7316.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Rat King, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Rat King trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2921-3240-5632-6462.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Chalk Outline triggers, creating a Treasure token, Clue token and creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1061-6568-7393.easyPrerequisites: You control a Shard that doesn't have summoning sickness.
1061-6568-7393.description:
Activate Niko by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling Timestream Navigator and causing Shards you control to become a copy of Timestream Navigator until the end step.
Activate a Shard by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of the next end step, Timestream Navigator is returned from exile to the battlefield. Y'shtola Rhul then triggers, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Repeat each turn.

2743-6570-7063.description:
Cast Mnemonic Deluge by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, exiling Ember Island Production and casting three copies of it without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the three Ember Island Production copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

2741-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2741-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

560-2425-4550-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2425-4550-5147.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Smothering Abomination triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities.
Repeat.

290-617-4235-4547.description:
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Forsaken Monument triggers, adding {C}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Dreamstone Hedron.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Dreamstone Hedron.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

969-3259-5485.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
969-3259-5485.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

618-2104-3662-4836.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {1}{R}{R} each extra turn
618-2104-3662-4836.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Izzet Chemister.
Activate the Izzet Chemister token's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your end step, Kiki-Jiki triggers, but you cannot sacrifice the Izzet Chemister token due to The Master.
On your next turn, activate the Izzet Chemister token's last ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, casting the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Resolve that spell, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

337-3297-4222-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one artifact.
Freed from the Real attached to Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Embraal Gear-Smasher does not have summoning sickness.
337-3297-4222-4508.description:
Cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Pirate" on Malcolm to "Human" or "Warrior" until end of turn.
Activate Embraal Gear-Smasher by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage by Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Repeat from step 2.

678-1636-3558-5098.notablePrerequisites: Grima Wormtongue does not have summoning sickness.
678-1636-3558-5098.description:
Activate Grima Wormtongue by tapping it and sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grima Wormtongue ability, causing target player to lose 1 life.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1616-2349-5168.notablePrerequisites: Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
1616-2349-5168.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {W}{U}{R}{G}.
Activate Mistmeadow Witch by paying {2}{W}{U}, exiling Realm Razer until the beginning of your end step.
When Realm Razer leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning the exiled lands to the battlefield tapped under their owner's control.
At the beginning of your end step, Mistmeadow Witch triggers, returning Realm Razer from exile to the battlefield.
When Realm Razer enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling all lands.
Repeat.

222-1608-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-1608-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Triplicate Titan and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {1}{B}.
When Triplicate Titan dies, it triggers, creating three 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing two Golems, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Triplicate Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

464-1022.easyPrerequisites:
Lord Xander does not have summoning sickness.
Fraying Sanity is attached to an opponent.
464-1022.description:
Declare Lord Xander as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing the defending player to mill half their library, rounded down.
At the beginning of your end step, Fraying Sanity triggers, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to the number of cards put into their graveyard this turn.

618-2493-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer with haste.
The token copy of Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1424-1950-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Devoted Druid.
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
1424-1950-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior token.
Activate Devoted Druid by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
